# P35.66 — Residential demotion wired (SIG-PUB-004/005/013): automatic C3 demotion on residential-parcel intersection; no residential candidate published

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/288_P35.66__residential-demotion.md`
(manifest row **288**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B — lands before row
290's Wave-B activation legs). **Requirement ids satisfied:**
**SIG-PUB-004**, **SIG-PUB-005**, **SIG-PUB-013**. **Cited (context;
owned elsewhere):** SIG-PUB-011 (a `CandidateAsset` never appears in a
public device layer — P37.10 owns promotion), SIG-PUB-012 (promotion
requires field/imagery confirmation — P37.10), SIG-PUB-006 (the C1
default stands; the demotion is the override), §23.10 (`rf_candidates`
writes `CandidateAsset` only). **Base:** `r11/P35.1a1-seed-declared-jobs`
· **Branch:** `r11/P35.66-residential-demotion` · **Production
mutations:** none — wiring, a declared parcel-signal config, fixtures and
tests only (`live_verification=false`; no live classification/backfill,
no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate tick). **CI config changed:** no.

## Why

`demote_for_residential_parcel` and `candidate_publishable` were dead
code (TS-07 — `policy/sensitivity.py:57` had no non-test caller) while
Part VIII binds: a device candidate intersecting a residential parcel
must demote to C3 automatically, precise geometry must be withheld, and
no residential candidate may reach any public surface at any precision,
ever — and an unscreened geography must never be silently treated as
clear (§3.1).

## What ships

- **The declared parcel signal** — `policy/src/policy/parcel_screen.py`
  + `policy/src/policy/data/residential_parcels.toml`: a committed,
  versioned signal (id, version, provenance, coverage rings, parcel
  rings) with a fail-closed integrity check (`signal_doc_violations` —
  malformed/open rings, out-of-range positions, a parcel centroid
  outside declared coverage are config defects, never verdicts). The
  verdict is three-valued: `intersects` | `clear` | `unscreened` — and
  the emitted record names the signal that produced it
  (`parcel_screen_signal` = `<id>@<version>`). Re-confirmation
  (2026-10-15, `date -u`): the spine holds no parcel layer, so the
  committed signal honestly declares **zero coverage** — every emitted
  point records `unscreened` until the acquisition row (P35.6 path)
  lands. Tests inject `tests/unit/fixtures/parcels/residential_parcels.toml`.
- **The demotion wired at every `sensitivity_class` stamping site** —
  `dot_511._entry_from_raw` (screens the point BEFORE the tier transform;
  `intersects` → C3 + geo-tier 3 + latitude/longitude withheld + the
  flag/verdict/signal stamped on entity AND claim rows; non-point rows
  record `unscreened`), `osm._normalize_asset` (point/center screened;
  flagged asset rows demote C1→C3 and `physical_asset_rows` withholds
  the geometry — program facts and provenance retained; bounds-free
  rows record `unscreened`), `okc_claim` / `dossier_claim`
  (`intersects_residential`/`parcel_screen` params, closed-vocabulary +
  consistency validation, automatic demotion, signal stamped; documents
  with no device geography default `unscreened`). `flock_portal` emits
  no `sensitivity_class` and no device geometry — recorded N/A.
- **The publication refusal** — `policy.sensitivity` gains
  `CandidateAssetPublishRefused` + `assert_public_layer_subject`
  (flagged subjects refused at any precision, `candidate_asset`
  refused always). Enforced as a **build error** at every public
  surface: `exports/shaping.py` (`subject_entities` LEFT JOINs
  `candidate_asset.residential_parcel_flag`; refused subjects never
  shape a site — counted honestly in `candidate_subjects_excluded` —
  and a post-shape `assert_public_layer_subject` guard fails the build
  on a smuggled site), `spine_export._slice_sites` (the refusal rides
  every per-(source, rights) slice), `published_record.record_from_site_row`,
  `search_index.build_search_index` (refuses BEFORE the sqlite file is
  opened — no partial artifact), `tiles.slim_geojson_for_tiles`
  (refuses on the full feature properties before slimming), and
  `research_dossier.validate_packet` (a flagged subject or a flagged
  claim record is a packet violation → `build_dossier` raises).
- **`sig-connectors validate`** — loads + integrity-checks the declared
  signal through `policy._data`'s loader (the signal lives in `policy`,
  not `connectors`); a malformed signal fails validation.

## Test coverage

`tests/unit/test_policy_parcel_screen.py` (**14** — every verdict,
open/degenerate/out-of-range rings, parcel-outside-coverage, the refusal
helper) · dot_511 parcel cases (intersects → C3+flag+no coordinate
claims; off-parcel → declared class+`clear`; outside coverage →
`unscreened`; demotion over a pinned non-C3 class) · OSM (parcel asset →
flag/verdict; `physical_asset_rows` withholds geometry while program
facts survive; bounds/geometry-free → `unscreened`) · OKC + dossier
demotion/stamp cases · `tests/exports/test_p35_66_publish_refusal.py`
(**9** — no site for candidate/flagged subjects, honest exclusion
count, post-shape guard on a smuggled site, record/search/tile/dossier
refusals, 2-column back-compat rows). `sig-connectors validate` green.

## Deviations / deferrals

- The emitted claim-level parcel stamp fields ride the emitted record
  (the evidence row); the spine-visible flag lands on the
  `candidate_asset.residential_parcel_flag` column (P35.19's carrier)
  via the `subject_entities` projection — no schema change.
- The partner-fixture golden `text_claim_digests.json` was re-goldened
  on `dot_511_wa` (22 digests) — the emit rows legitimately gained the
  three parcel-stamp fields (precedent: P32.3/P35.9/P35.15a; `_note`
  updated). No other run's digests changed.
- No DEFERRALS row opened: the parcel-dataset acquisition is the
  contract-named P35.6 registry path (out of scope here), and the
  empty-coverage signal records `unscreened` honestly in the interim.
- Local `make check` posture matches the recorded base: the two
  `test_p34_18_aliases` handle sweeps fail only because the operator's
  gitignored handle list is present locally (32 hits, all in committed
  P34.39a records; this diff adds zero handle strings — the recorded
  P34.39a `fail` class); `test_secrets` is green armed with
  `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` (OP-07 repo variable). CI arms/skips both.
